list: The official 55 trophies, as PlayStation lists them; names, descriptions and grades as published. List facts cross-checked against Exophase and the guides below.

facts.time: About 200 hours (PowerPyx: 60–80 h story, ~100 h checklist, 10–20 h cleanup)
facts.playthroughs: One — no New Game+, no mission replay, free-roam continues after the story
facts.online: 0 online trophies — every trophy is offline, single-player
facts.cheats: Cheats disable trophies and saving — keep them off for a trophy run (GTABase)
facts.hidden: 28 of the 55 trophies stay hidden on PlayStation until earned
facts.missableNote: Only one trophy is reported as possibly missable: Positive Mental Attitude. Everything else can be finished after the story.

roadmap.title: Play the story
roadmap.summary: Finish all five chapters as Jason and Lucia, and take optional missions as they appear — many are only offered for a while. Scan vehicles and study animals along the way; that progress already counts toward the 100% checklist even though the checklist itself only appears after the story.
steps: After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning. When she says she is going to meditate, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. This is the one possibly missable step in the whole game — do it before Chapter 1 ends.
Save manually at the start and end of every chapter. There is no mission replay, so a missed story moment cannot be redone without a new playthrough.
Do not use cheats: they disable trophies and saving. Avoid the Irredeemable criminal profile — it is permanent.
Start Stranger mission chains as soon as they unlock; some are tied to story progress.

roadmap.title: Reach 100% completion
roadmap.summary: After the credits, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, and work through what is left. The checklist's thresholds are lenient — PowerPyx puts them at roughly 60% of true completion — and most of the progress comes from the other trophies.
steps: Robberies: 39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs and 8 bank vault robberies.
Collectibles: 15 Collectible Card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries and 100 Cocaine Flamingos.
Complete 70 of the 80 challenges, earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, win Top Fun drone races and finish Bret's quests.
Trophy targets sit below checklist targets in places: 250 stunts (checklist 300), 20 races won (30), 50 challenges (70), 3 card sets (15), 5 bank vaults (8).

roadmap.title: Strangers & cleanup
roadmap.summary: Finish the eight Strangers & Freaks strands and the character questlines, then mop up whatever is left. Every quest giver tied to a trophy is available again in free-roam after the story.
steps: Complete the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, and finish Bret's unique-animal hunt.
Complete eight qualifying Stranger mission strands across Leonida.
Finish the remaining meditation spots, then check the list for any miscellaneous trophies still missing.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Follow the roadmap in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then Strangers and cleanup. PowerPyx rates the whole run about 200 hours at difficulty 4 out of 10, all offline and in a single playthrough.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Just play Gone Fishing, the opening mission, to the end. It pops when the mission completes, so there is nothing to prepare and nothing that can be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It pops when you finish the last mission of Chapter 1. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation with Lucia described in Positive Mental Attitude — that one step is the game's only possibly missable trophy moment.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It pops when you finish the last mission of Chapter 2. The final meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude only becomes reachable once you can play as both characters, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It pops when you finish the last mission of Chapter 3. Keep taking optional missions as they appear; several are only offered for a while, though none of them locks a trophy.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It pops when you finish the last mission of Chapter 4. The optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… is worth doing now: it opens the bank-vault route that Maximum Withdrawal needs.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It pops when you finish the final story mission. After the credits you stay in free-roam, the 100% checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, and every trophy-related quest giver is available again.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play the mission Breakfast Run to the end. There is no special requirement — finishing the mission is the whole trophy.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play the mission The Cartel Heist to the end. It is one of the named story missions, so it pops on completion like the others.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play the mission Child's Play to the end. No preparation and no side objective are needed for it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play the mission Headliners to the end. It pops on completion, as all the named story-mission trophies do.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play the mission VCIA Takedown to the end. The airport area matters again later for Catch Me If You Can, which asks for an unscheduled departure from VCIA.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play the mission Operation Savage Glory to the end. Like the other story missions, finishing it is the entire requirement.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the one the Platinum waits on. After the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion to see the checklist. Its thresholds are lenient — PowerPyx puts them at roughly 60% of true completion — but it still asks for every robbery type, the collectibles, and 70 of the 80 challenges. Most of the progress comes from working on the other trophies, so do this stage second and let the checklist guide the cleanup.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida count, and the 100% checklist asks for 300, so the trophy pops first. Flying under bridges is reported to be the quickest kind of stunt, and stunt jumps you find while exploring all count toward the total. Keep an eye on the stunt counter in the Progress menu as you travel.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once: fishing, racing, the Shooting Range, drone races, arcade games, meditation, hunting, bowling and the other open-world activities the game counts. One try each is enough — you do not need to win or finish anything. It pops as soon as the ninth type is tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every one of the 42 Shooting Range challenges. The checklist asks for the same 42 golds, so this trophy and the checklist move together. Work through the ranges one at a time, learn each challenge's target pattern, and retry the ones you miss — challenges can be repeated freely.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — PowerPyx counts 42 races across those locations, so you will run several races per spot. Learn each course's corners before pushing for the win, and use the checklist's drone-race section to see which locations are still missing.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race only counts once, so you need 20 distinct events, not 20 wins in the same one. The 100% checklist asks for 30, so keep racing past this trophy. Mix vehicle types and keep a note of which races you have already won.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal at a fishing spot and beat him in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the nine activity types, so a session here also feeds Master of None. Take your time reeling — steady tension beats frantic pulling, and the challenge can be retried if Cal wins the first round.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Walk up to any arcade cabinet in Leonida and finish one full game. It does not matter which game you pick or how high you score — completing one run is the trophy. Arcade games also count as one of the nine activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's questline, then finish his final mission. Andy's missions are Lucia's strand, so play them as Lucia. Start the chain as soon as it unlocks and keep it going in free-roam after the story if it is not finished by then — quest givers stay available.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's questline, then finish his final mission. Work through his missions as they unlock and finish the chain in free-roam after the story if needed. Like the other character quest finals, it is not time-limited once the chain has started.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's questline, then finish his final mission. Keep doing his missions as they unlock during the story, and mop up the rest in free-roam. The quest givers remain available after the credits, so nothing here is permanently missed.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Eight complete strands are needed — a single mission in a strand does not count. Start stranger chains as soon as they appear, because some are tied to story progress, and keep checking the map for stranger icons in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's questline, then finish his final mission. Take his missions as they unlock and finish the chain in free-roam after the story if it is still open. It is one of the five named character quest finals, and each has its own trophy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's questline, then finish his final mission. Tyrone's missions are Jason's strand, so play them as Jason. Finish the chain in free-roam after the story if it is still open — the quest giver stays available.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot — GTABase counts 18 of them, though the 100% checklist counts 15, so the two lists disagree and the safest target is all 18. The first meditation is the game's one possibly missable step: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning. When she says she is going to meditate, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept — it is unclear whether this one is required for the trophy, so do it to be safe. The final meditation spot only becomes reachable once you can play as both characters, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret and bring it back to him. Bret's missions are Jason's strand, and the checklist counts his quests among the cleanup steps. Which animal counts as unique is not yet confirmed by the guides — check Bret's quest text in-game for the animal he asks for, and treat that as the target. Do not rely on other players' guesses.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three full Collectible Card sets. There are 15 sets in total and the 100% checklist asks for all 15, so the trophy pops a fifth of the way through that hunt. Cards are scattered across Leonida — pick up every card you spot while travelling, and use the checklist's card section to see which sets are still short.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations. The checklist asks for the same 100, so this trophy and the checklist finish together. WAiNK every new location you pass through during the story — it is far quicker to build the count as you travel than to backtrack for it later.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges, arranged in eight groups of ten. The checklist asks for 70, so this trophy pops well before the checklist is done. Challenges cover driving, flying, shooting, collecting and more — many complete themselves while you chase the other trophies, so check the challenge menu regularly and pick off the ones that are close.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside you, build a four-star wanted level and then escape it — you must break the heat, not just survive it. Bank vault robberies often bring a wanted level naturally, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia is reported to be a reliable place to lose the police. Wait until the heat zone on the map is clear before relaxing.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row while keeping your wanted level the whole time — if the heat drops before the third shop, the chain breaks and you start again. The jewelry stores in North Vice City sit close together, which makes the run short. If it does not pop after the third shop, rob a fourth before letting the heat go.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by scanning them with WAiNK — you do not need to drive them, so scanning traffic on busy roads is efficient. Park on a busy road, scan each new vehicle that passes, and let the count build. Every vehicle you scan while travelling counts toward the total.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Fill your Focus meter first, then pick a fight with gang members — they count. Cops, soldiers and civilians are reported not to count, so aim for gang members specifically. An assault rifle makes the five kills fast enough to fit inside one Focus window.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Get into a docked passenger jet at Vice City International Airport and fly roughly a kilometre away from the airport. Steal the jet on the ground, take off, and keep flying until the trophy pops — no destination is needed. Expect airport security on the way in, so go in ready for a fight or slip in quietly.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it. The Rhino tank is the target — get in, and use its cannon on the enemies that come after you. Expect heavy resistance at the base, so plan a quick way in and a fast route out once the kills are done.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at any point. Open the store's back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code, and clear the safe without anyone spotting you. Move slowly, stay out of sight lines, and leave before the alarm can be raised — being spotted at any stage voids the attempt.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. This needs the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… — without it the vault route is not open. In that mission, follow a security van into a bank while its vault is open, grab the cash, and get out. Expect a four-star wanted level on the way out, so have a fast bike ready before you go in.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape with the cash. Find a truck on the road, stop it, take the money, and lose the wanted level that follows. A quick vehicle parked nearby makes the escape much easier.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every area of Leonida — the map tracks 52 areas, and the trophy pops when the fog is cleared across all of them. Flying over the dark patches of the map is reported to be the quickest way to clear them. Use the map's fog as your checklist: any dark patch is a place you have not been.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs in Leonida — one per gang, not nine total from one gang. Gang Operations are part of the 100% checklist too (39 of them), so work on this alongside the checklist and keep a note of which gangs you have already hit.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The official description is the whole clue: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed by the guides — PowerPyx marks this trophy as not yet known. Head to Ocean Beach, find a bar or viewpoint with a view over the water, and order a cocktail there. Do not trust any specific location claim that has no source behind it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The exact trigger is not yet confirmed by the guides — PowerPyx marks this trophy as not yet known. GTABase's unconfirmed idea is to crash a car out through a showroom window, in the style of the classic showroom smash. Try a vehicle showroom with a car, but treat the window idea as an unconfirmed guess, not a confirmed method.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl. The wording of the official description is unclear, and the guides list this trophy without a confirmed method, so the safe reading is: play a full game at that specific alley and follow through the game. If it does not pop, try completing a game rather than leaving partway.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both characters. Strength is one of the character stats, raised by physical activity — work on it for Jason and for Lucia until each stat bar is full. GTABase lists this as the method; the vague official description gives no other clue.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. The number comes from GTABase and is a single-source claim, so treat it as the best available figure rather than a confirmed fact. Work on it naturally during the rest of the run — the profile changes as you make choices and commit crimes. One warning first: the Irredeemable profile is permanent, so check how the Criminal Profile works before a rampage.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The exact trigger is not yet confirmed — PowerPyx marks this trophy as not yet known, and the official description gives only the hint 'Second time's the charm.' Do not follow any specific method claim that has no source behind it; this one is still waiting on the guides to pin it down.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The exact trigger is not yet confirmed. GTABase reports that it refers to a strange event somewhere in Leonida, but the event, the place and the trigger are all unconfirmed. Explore Leonida's odd corners and unusual encounters in free-roam, and check the guides again once one of them confirms the event.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The exact trigger is not yet confirmed — PowerPyx marks this trophy as not yet known. The description itself is the method: bowl someone over with a melee drive-by, that is, attack a person with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle so they are knocked down. Try it on a pedestrian from a slow-moving vehicle with a melee weapon equipped.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through contacts — the fences who take them. One fence is reported to pay the most, so compare their rates before you sell. Your total grows during the robbery-heavy 100% checklist work, since those jobs pay in Marked Bills, so keep laundering as you go rather than saving it all for the end.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops in Leonida. Clothes, weapons, vehicles and upgrades all count, and the total is cumulative across every shop. You will spend much of this naturally on gear, garage properties and vehicles during the rest of the run — check your spending total in the stats if it has not popped by the cleanup stage.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight garage properties through the Vice City Real Estate app, for about $160,000 in total. The four garages you get from the story do not count — only the eight you buy yourself. Save the money during the story, then buy them all in the cleanup stage.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten different vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles you have not registered yet, open the app, and register each one — ten distinct vehicles are needed. Scan vehicles with WAiNK first so you know which ones you have found, and register the ones you drive regularly.
